brightness step confirmed on all 5 pairs: mean_shift monotonic with clipped_fraction (clip 49.4%->-36.3, 35.7%->-43.9, 24.2%->-46.1, 13.2%->-49.0, 10.3%->-49.3) and unique_G=202-203 per channel; additive RGB shift sev3 (c=0.2=51 levels), gamma_RGB:2 rejected at 26.32 dB on pair0 with impulse_pct_255 mismatch
pair1 zero-clipping mismatch under gaussian blur (target 10.3% vs sim 4.5%) resolved when the blur kernel is motion:1
analysis.rationale: R0 ignored the mandatory motion rule (residual_anisotropy>1.7) and tested glass:3 instead, leaving blur subtype/severity unresolved (best pair1 19.96 dB). Signal reinterpretation pointed to blur_motion:1 (radius5/sigma3) + brightness_darken_shfit_RGB:3 (c=0.2). This pipeline reproduced support pair1 at 58.91 dB / CI 10/10 (R29) and pair0 43.01, pair2 inf (bit-exact), pair3 36.66, pair4 37.56 dB / CI 10/10 on all five pairs; every pair improves by >= +6.21 dB over R0. >=40 dB met on 3/5 pairs and +2 dB met on 5/5 pairs -> CHANGE.
analysis.caveat: blur_motion draws a random angle np.random.uniform(-90,90) at simulation time (x_distortion). A repeat of the identical pipeline on pair1 (R30) drew a mismatched kernel and scored 17.64 dB; 5 of 6 motion runs hit the GT-equivalent kernel. The evidence for the pipeline is the bit-exact/CI-10/10 reproductions, not a single drawing.
